Tooling_Normalization.python_stack: Python is the default systems glue language. Use uv for environment, dependency, and project management. Use FastAPI for seam validation and separation of duties. Use Pydantic v2 for all critical handoffs. Use pytest for architecture, contract, and behavior verification.
Tooling_Normalization.modeling_stack: SysML v2 by SysIDE documentation standards is the architecture SSOT. Gaphor is the model-backed diagram and view layer, not authority over the textual baseline.
Tooling_Normalization.math_stack: Prefer SymPy for symbolic proof and constraints. Prefer SciPy and NumPy for deterministic numerical evaluation and physics.
Tooling_Normalization.telemetry_stack: DuckDB is the flight recorder. Polars is preferred for analytics, with Pandas only if Polars is unavailable.
Tooling_Normalization.control_stack: transitions is preferred for executable state-machine realization. NetworkX is the symbolic topology and reachability engine.
Tooling_Normalization.ml_stack: scikit-learn for anomaly detection and lightweight ML. PyTorch for learned models. OpenCV for deterministic perception pre-processing. OpenVLA via LeRobot for reflexive VLA tasks only when justified. Dreamer v3 for long-horizon predictive world modeling only when justified.
Tooling_Normalization.sim_stack: Faker, SDV, SimPy, Monte Carlo perturbation, and NetworkX sabotage analysis are the adversarial and synthetic test forge.
Tooling_Normalization.deployment_stack: TypeScript, Docker, Kubernetes, and MISRA C++23 are used according to partitioned runtime needs, not as decoration.
Tooling_Normalization.hil_stack: Streamlit or React for observation, dashboards, remote access, and HIL surfaces. Plotly and Seaborn are preferred for visuals, with Matplotlib as fallback.
Tooling_Normalization.engagement_rules: Symbolic over neural. Never pass raw tensor outputs directly to actuators. Log everything important. Prefer native open-source implementations. Prefer Marimo notebooks over Jupyter notebooks.
